english:
"God [be] unto me" [Psalm 53:1 [54:1], incipit: "God, in your name"]. "We bless you" [hymn]. "At all times." "And again in peace [let us beseech the Lord]." "Blessing and glory to the Father." And say six [canons] of the Psalter consecutively.
First Psalm 24 [25], say in full: "To you, O Lord, I lift up my soul." "Judge me, O Lord, for I have walked in my integrity" [Psalm 25 [26]]. "The Lord is my light and my salvation" [Psalm 26 [27]]. Afterward: "Glory to the Father." "Now and always." "And again in peace let us beseech the Lord." Blessing and glory.
Second [canon] Psalm 27 [28]: "To you, O Lord, I cry." "Ascribe to the Lord, O sons of God" [Psalm 28 [29]]. "I will extol you, O Lord" [Psalm 29 [30]]. Afterward: as above.
Third [canon] Psalm 30 [31]: "In you, O Lord, I have hoped." "Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven" [Psalm 31 [32]]. Afterward: as above.
Fourth [canon] Psalm 36 [37]: "Do not fret" [or "Do not be envious"]. Afterward: as above.
Fifth [canon] Psalm 37 [38]: "O Lord, do not rebuke me in your anger." "I said, I will guard [my ways]" [Psalm 38 [39]]. "With patience I waited" [Psalm 39 [40]]. Afterward: as above.
Sixth [canon] Psalm 40 [41]: "Blessed is he who considers [the poor]." "As the deer pants" [Psalm 41 [42]]. "Vindicate me, O God" [Psalm 42 [43]]. Afterward: as above.
And then the prayer of Jonah the Prophet, 2:3: "Out of my affliction... to verse 10: my vow for salvation." Afterward: "Glory to the Father and the Son." "Now and [always]."
And falling on their knees, they shall begin the hymn [sharakan] in Tone Plagal Fourth [dk], lamenting voice: "Terrified, it trembled" [Zarhuryal doghatsav], repeat three times. Afterward: "And again in peace." "Blessing and [glory]." Again, the prayer of Jonah the Prophet: "Out of my affliction." Afterward: "Glory to the Father." "Now and always." Hymn [sharakan]: "Since willingly" [Kanzi kamav], three times. Afterward: "And again in peace." "Blessing and [glory]."
Again, the prayer of Jonah the Prophet: "Out of my affliction." Afterward: "Glory to the Father and." "Now and [always]." Hymn [sharakan]: "Now falling down" [Ard ankyal], three times.
And then: "[Lord] Almighty" [prayer]. Afterward: "Glory." "Now." Hymn [sharakan] in Tone Plagal Fourth [dk]: "Almighty expiator" [Amenakal kav], three times. Afterward: "Lord Almighty." Hymn [sharakan]: "And your Holy Spirit" [Yev zhogit surb], three times. Again: "Lord Almighty." Hymn [sharakan]: "And save me" [Yev prkya zis], three times. "We beseech and request." And afterward the Litany: "We who have come to confession" [Yekyalqs i khostovan]. Prayer: "Lord God of our salvation."
And then Psalm 50 [51], lamenting voice: "Purge me [with hyssop]," response: "Have mercy on me."
Prophet Isaiah 60:20: "And the days of your mourning shall be ended... to verse 22: I will gather them."
Prophet Ezekiel 36:24: "Thus says the Lord: And I will take... to verse 31: your iniquities."
Epistle Hebrews 10:19: "Therefore, brethren, having... to verse 21: of the living God."
Psalm 41 [42]: "As the deer pants," say in full.
Gospel Luke 7:36: "One of the Pharisees asked him... to verse 50: go in peace."
And the deacon shall proclaim the litany: "May the Lord hear the voice of our supplications, almighty Lord our God, save and have mercy." And say three times: "Lord have mercy," and then read the prayer of Saint Basil: "Lord God, Father Almighty."
After the prayers, Psalm 117 [118]: "Open to me [the gates of righteousness]," response: "Give thanks [to the Lord]," up to that place where it says: "Open to me."
And entering into the church, they shall begin the hymn [sharakan] in Tone Plagal Fourth [dk]: "The door of your mercy" [Zoghormutyan ko zdurn]. And upon its completion, Psalm 99 [100]: "Make a joyful noise unto the Lord," say in full.
Afterward the Litany: "Through this holy church." Prayer: "In the midst of this temple."
And then the bishop or the senior priest shall read the prayer of blessing over the penitents. Afterward the Litany: "Let us ask." And he shall say thirty times: "Lord have mercy." Prayer: "To your almighty [power]."
And they shall place the holy cross and the Gospel book before the altar, and they shall kiss them, and they shall give the four-drachma coin, which Moses commanded for the Levites. And the priest shall bless the penitents and dismiss them.
And at the sixth hour they shall assemble in the church, they shall cover the altar, and they shall say the remaining mercy-psalms [Oghormya]. And then they shall begin: "Incline [your ear]" and "Save [me]" [Psalms 85 and 142].
Messedi [Psalm verse] 25 [26]: "I will wash my hands in innocence," response: "O Lord, I have loved the beauty" [of your house].
Book of Genesis 22:1: "And it came to pass after... to verse 18: you have obeyed my voice."
Prophet Isaiah 61:1: "The Spirit of the Lord is upon me... to verse 7: upon their heads."
Acts of the Apostles...
